headline: Southern New Hampshire finish top of the conference table
dek: Southern New Hampshire's twenty points from nine matches still lead the table, one clear of Bentley, who climbed to nineteen by beating Assumption on Saturday in their tenth. American International sit third on seventeen; Saint Michael's and Pace share the foot of the table on four points.
displaced_by: Bentley's win over Assumption took them to nineteen points from ten table matches, so the standing dek's 'four clear of Bentley' and 'every member on nine matches' are no longer true; the headline still holds and stands

pattern.label: signal
pattern.text: Southern New Hampshire's fifty-two goals come from at least sixteen different scorers, so the tallest bar is the work of a squad rather than a single forward.

wire.line: Southern New Hampshire have scored fifty-two goals and conceded ten this season.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Guillermo Rios has scored sixteen of Franklin Pierce's thirty-three goals.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Pace have conceded thirty-eight goals, more than any other programme.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Southern Connecticut have drawn seven matches, more than any other programme.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Saint Anselm have won eight matches and lost eight, and remain the only programme yet to draw a match.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Javier Solá Martínez has kept eight clean sheets in goal for American International.

last_match.line: Another clean sheet for Javier Solá Martínez, and American International's second win over Adelphi this season.

next_match.line: Their October meeting at Southern New Hampshire ended goalless; Franklin Pierce arrive off a win at Saint Anselm.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
